## What's new
- **Dia comes to the front when a link goes to one of its profiles.** A link sent to a Dia profile used to land in that profile while Dia stayed behind the app you clicked in, often with another profile on screen. Now Dia comes forward, switches to the profile, and shows the new tab. - **Spotify and Apple Music links can open in their apps.** Both are new switches under "Open in app" in Settings → Rules, beside Figma, Notion, Teams and Zoom. A shared track, album, playlist, artist, episode or show then opens in the app rather than the web player.
